subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should the room-event cache-stability fix make model-visible tool inventories stable across normal automatic turns and strict room_event turns, or should this PR intentionally solve only the system-prompt and room-event-by-sender parts?
rationale: Stabilizing the tool inventory may add or retain model-visible tools in places that currently keep a smaller automatic or room-event surface, so review cannot infer the intended security and product boundary from code alone.

options.title: Stabilize All Prompt And Tool Surfaces
options.body: Require the PR to carry the prompt-facing mode through Codex, memory flush, and model-visible tool construction so the linked cache-churn report is actually fixed before merge.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Partial Fix
options.body: Merge only the system-prompt and room-event-by-sender stabilization while leaving the linked issue open for the remaining Codex, memory, and tool-inventory churn.

options.title: Pause For Boundary Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a broader room-event privacy and tool-visibility design before changing any more prompt-cache surfaces.

recommendation.title: Stabilize All Prompt And Tool Surfaces
recommendation.body: Require the PR to carry the prompt-facing mode through Codex, memory flush, and model-visible tool construction so the linked cache-churn report is actually fixed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room product contract introduced in their prior policy work.
